messages.subject: Project Polaris - confidentiality agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Further to our call, I attach the confidentiality agreement for signature by Larkfield ahead of disclosure. It is in our usual form - two-year term, mutual non-solicit. Grateful for any comments, otherwise please arrange signature.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
+44 (0)20 7946 0044
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
